claims: C1 the example contrasts a good assistant that proposes a safe approach with a bad assistant that acts without considering side effects
C2 the good approach is to show the list before unsubscribing and to archive instead of delete, so the user can recover
C3 the bad approach is to begin bulk unsubscribing and deleting without showing what will be affected or asking for confirmation on borderline cases

concepts.name: assistant_response
concepts.gloss: A is a response made by the assistant in the example
concepts.inference: the example is built around two assistant responses, so a predicate for an assistant response is needed

concepts.name: considers_side_effects
concepts.gloss: response A takes into account the example side effects E listed in the control side effects section
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract supplies the meaning of side_effect_examples; the example's contrast requires a relation between a response and those examples

concepts.name: side_effect_examples
concepts.gloss: E is one of the example side effects given in the control side effects section
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to side effects without defining the list

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule that carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest level that cannot be overridden by system, developer or user instructions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define root authority

asserts.read_back: an assistant response that considers the example side effects and proposes a safe approach is the good behaviour in this example
an assistant response that acts without considering the example side effects is the bad behaviour in this example

closure.reason: the example presents the safe approach as the good behaviour, not as a strict requirement; it does not forbid other approaches outright
the example labels acting without considering side effects as bad, so silence about such acts is read as prohibiting them
